useForm.summary: Vue composable for complete form lifecycle.

options.name: data
options.description: Initial form data (required)

options.name: rules
options.description:
Validation rules by dot-path
Supports wildcards for arrays: 'items.*.name'

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Submission endpoint URL

options.name: method
options.description: HTTP method for submission (default: POST)

options.name: transform
options.description: Transform data before submission

returns.name: isDirty
returns.description: True if data differs from initial snapshot

returns.name: isValid
returns.description: True if no errors and all rules pass

returns.name: isSubmitting
returns.description: True while submission is in progress

returns.name: setError
returns.description: Set an error for a path

returns.name: clearErrors
returns.description: Clear errors (all or for a specific path)

usePagination.summary: Vue composable for server-side paginated data fetching.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: API endpoint to fetch paginated data from (required)

options.name: perPage
options.description: Number of items per page (default: 25)

options.name: params
options.type: Ref<Record<string, unknown>, Record<string, unknown>> | ComputedRef<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined
options.description:
Reactive query params to include in requests.
Any change triggers a refetch and resets to page 1.

options.name: syncUrl
options.description: Sync pagination state with URL query params (default: false)

returns.name: isLoading
returns.description: Whether a request is in flight

returns.name: error
returns.description: Error from last request (null on success)

useInfiniteScroll.summary:
Infinite scroll composable for Vue 3

Automatically loads more data as the user scrolls, using IntersectionObserver
for performance.

options.name: perPage
options.description: Number of items per page (default: 15)

options.name: scrollElement
options.type: Ref<HTMLElement | null, HTMLElement | null> | (() => HTMLElement | null) | undefined
options.description:
Element to observe for scroll position.
Can be a ref, a function returning an element, or undefined for window.

options.name: threshold
options.description: Distance from bottom (in px) to trigger loading (default: 200)

options.name: immediate
options.description: Start loading automatically on mount (default: true)

options.name: cursor
options.description: Use cursor-based pagination instead of page numbers

options.name: params
options.description: Custom query params to include with each request

options.name: direction
options.description: Direction to load more items: 'down' appends, 'up' prepends (default: 'down')

options.name: transform
options.description: Transform each item after fetching

options.name: keyField
options.description: Unique key field for deduplication (default: 'id')

options.name: http
options.description: Custom HTTP instance to use

returns.name: items
returns.description: All loaded items as a reactive Collection

returns.name: hasMore
returns.description: Whether there are more items to load

returns.name: reset
returns.description: Reset and reload from the beginning

returns.name: sentinelRef
returns.description: Ref to attach to the sentinel element for intersection observation

useLiveData.summary:
Live data composable for Vue 3

Fetches data via HTTP and keeps it synchronized via WebSocket.

options.name: channel
options.description: WebSocket channel to subscribe to

options.name: event
options.description: Specific event name to listen for

options.name: model
options.description: Model configuration for automatic CRUD event handling

options.name: merge
options.description: How to merge incoming events with current data

options.name: keyField
options.description: Key field for upsert/delete operations (default: 'id')

options.name: transform
options.description: Transform data after fetching or receiving events

options.name: immediate
options.description: Whether to fetch data immediately on mount (default: true)

options.name: socketUrl
options.description: WebSocket URL (default: auto-detect from window.location)

options.name: http
options.description: Custom HTTP instance

options.name: params
options.description: Custom params for initial HTTP request

options.name: asCollection
options.description: Return data as Collection instead of array (default: true)

returns.name: data
returns.description: The reactive data (Collection or array based on options)

returns.name: loading
returns.description: Whether initial load is in progress

returns.name: refresh
returns.description: Manually refresh data from the server

returns.name: remove
returns.description: Remove an item locally by key

useQueryState.summary:
Query state composable for Vue 3

Provides two-way binding between reactive state and URL query parameters.

returns.name: getAll
returns.description: Get all current values as an object

returns.name: setAll
returns.type: (values: Partial<{ [K in keyof S]: ExtractValueType<S[K]>; }>) => void

returns.name: getUrl
returns.description: Get the current URL with query params

useLazyLoad.summary:
Lazy load composable for Vue 3

Defers data fetching until an element enters the viewport.

options.name: rootMargin
options.description:
Root margin for IntersectionObserver (default: '0px')
Use positive values like '100px' to pre-load before element is visible

options.name: threshold
options.description:
Threshold for visibility (0-1, default: 0)
0 = trigger when any part visible, 1 = trigger when fully visible

options.name: immediate
options.description:
Whether to fetch immediately when visible (default: true)
Set to false to manually trigger with load()

options.name: once
options.description: Only load once, even if element leaves and re-enters viewport (default: true)

options.name: root
options.type: Ref<HTMLElement | null, HTMLElement | null> | (() => HTMLElement | null) | undefined
options.description: Custom root element for intersection (default: viewport)

returns.name: visible
returns.description: Whether the element is visible in viewport

returns.name: loaded
returns.description: Whether data has been loaded at least once

returns.name: error
returns.description: Any error that occurred during loading

returns.name: targetRef
returns.description: Ref to attach to the target element

usePresence.summary:
Real-time collaborative presence composable

Enables seeing who else is on a page, where their cursor is, and what they're focused on.

options.name: channel
options.description:
Laravel broadcast channel name
Convention: project-scoped channels like 'customers' or 'project.{id}'

options.name: user
options.description:
Current user's identity - broadcast to other clients
id is required; name/avatar/colour are common additions

options.name: autoJoin
options.description: Whether to automatically join on mount (default: true)

options.name: throttleMs
options.description: Throttle interval for cursor broadcasts in ms (default: 50)

options.name: socketUrl
options.description: WebSocket URL (default: auto-detect from window.location)

returns.name: focus
returns.description:
Broadcast what the user is focused on (row id, field, etc.)
Pass null to clear focus

returns.name: setMeta
returns.description:
Broadcast arbitrary metadata
Meta is shallow-merged, not replaced

returns.name: join
returns.description: Manually join channel (auto-called on mount unless autoJoin: false)
